q: (Only Allaah knows the correct meaning of these letters.)
v.s: Hā, Meem.
v.c: Ḥâ-Mĩm.
v.h: The Quran Is from the Almighty

q: This Book is revealed from Allaah, the Mighty, the All Knowing.
v.s: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,
v.c: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Knowing,

q: The Forgiver of sins, Acceptor of repentance, Severe
in punishment, and All Powerful. There is no Ilaah but He, and all
v.s: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
v.c: the Forgiver of sin and Accepter of repentance, the Severe in punishment, and Infinite in bounty. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. To Him ˹alone˺ is the final return.

q: It is only those who commit kufr who argue about Allaah's Aayaat
(an act for which they will soon be punished).
So let not their travelling about through the lands
(their apparent freedom to do as they please)
(into thinking that they will not be punished. Allaah is allowing them grace only until the period He has destined for their punishment).
v.s: No one disputes concerning the signs of God except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.
v.c: None disputes the signs of Allah except the disbelievers, so do not be deceived by their prosperity throughout the land.

q: Before them, the nation of Nooh ﵊ rejected
as well as the many groups after them. Every nation resolved
their Rasool and they used falsehood to argue in an effort to refute
v.s: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
v.c: Before them, the people of Noah denied ˹the truth˺, as did ˹other˺ enemy forces afterwards. Every community plotted against its prophet to seize him, and argued in falsehood, ˹hoping˺ to discredit the truth with it. So I seized them. And how ˹horrible˺ was My punishment!

q: of your Rabb has been passed
against the Kaafiroon; that they shall certainly be from among the inmates of the Fire.
v.s: And thus has the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
v.c: And so your Lord’s decree has been proven true against the disbelievers—that they will be the inmates of the Fire.

q: The angels carrying the Throne, as well as those around them, glorify the praises of their Rabb, believe in Him, and seek forgiveness for those who have Imaan.
“O our Rabb! Your mercy and knowledge encompass
everything. So forgive those who repent and who follow Your path. And save them from the punishment of the Blaze
v.s: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [God] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
v.c: Those ˹angels˺ who carry the Throne and those around it glorify the praises of their Lord, have faith in Him, and seek forgiveness for the believers, ˹praying:˺ “Our Lord! You encompass everything in ˹Your˺ mercy and knowledge. So forgive those who repent and follow Your Way, and protect them from the torment of the Hellfire.

q: “O our Rabb! Admit them into the Jannaat of eternity, which You have promised them, as well as the righteous ones from among their fathers, their spouses, and their progeny
(allow them all to live together in Jannah as they did in the world).
Undoubtedly, You are the Mighty, the Wise.”
v.s: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
v.c: Our Lord! Admit them into the Gardens of Eternity which You have promised them, along with the righteous among their parents, spouses, and descendants. You ˹alone˺ are truly the Almighty, All-Wise.

m: You have bestowed mercy on him
q: You have certainly showered Your mercy on the one whom You have saved from difficulties on that day
This is indeed the greatest success.”
v.s: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."
v.c: And protect them from ˹the consequences of their˺ evil deeds. For whoever You protect from the evil of their deeds on that Day will have been shown Your mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the ultimate triumph.”

m: will be cried out to them
q: Verily it will be announced to those who committed kufr
(on the Day of Qiyaamah, when they will be entering Jahannam and cursing themselves for not accepting Imaan),
“Undoubtedly, Allaah's hatred for you is worse than your hatred for yourselves.
('You have only yourselves to blame for your predicament because)
When you were called towards Imaan, you rejected
v.s: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of God for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused]."
v.c: Indeed, it will be announced to the disbelievers, “Allah’s contempt for you—as you disbelieved when invited to belief—was far worse than your contempt for one another ˹Today˺.”

q: (Whereas in the world we denied life after death, we now admit that)
(before our births and after living our lives)
(when we were born and now after death).
our sins, so is there any way to escape
(punishment)?” (It will then be made clear to them that the opportunity to ask for forgiveness had passed in the world and that they will have to remain in Jahannam forever.)
v.s: They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"
v.c: They will plead, “Our Lord! You made us lifeless twice, and gave us life twice. Now we confess our sins. So is there any way out?”

q: (It will be further said to them)
is because you disbelieved each time that Allaah Alone
was mentioned. However, whenever partners were ascribed to Him, you believed
Judgement shall be for Allaah, the Exalted, the Great.”
(Because your crime was against such a Great Being, the punishment needs to be just as great.)
v.s: [They will be told], "That is because, when God was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with God, the Most High, the Grand."
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “˹No!˺ This is because when Allah alone was invoked, you ˹staunchly˺ disbelieved. But when others were associated with Him ˹in worship˺, you ˹readily˺ believed. So ˹Today˺ judgment belongs to Allah ˹alone˺—the Most High, All-Great.”

q: It is Allaah Who shows you His Aayaat
('so that you may realise His greatness and power),
for you from the sky. Only he who turns to Allaah will heed
(benefit from this and the other advice Allaah gives him).
v.s: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
v.c: He is the One Who shows you His signs and sends down ˹rain as˺ a provision for you from the sky. ˹But˺ none will be mindful except those who turn ˹to Him˺.

q: to Allaah, making all of religion
(without regarding any other as His partners),
even though the Kaafiroon dislike it.
v.s: So invoke God, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
v.c: So call upon Allah with sincere devotion, even to the dismay of the disbelievers.

q: (Do not think that you will lose any honour or status by attracting the (displeasure of the Kuffaar because Allaah is))
and the Owner of the Throne.
(By worshipping Only Him, He will grant you honour, wealth and status.)
By His command, He sends revelation to those bondsmen
(with Him, on the Day of Qiyaamah).
v.s: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command [i.e., revelation] upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
v.c: ˹He is˺ Highly Exalted in rank, Lord of the Throne. He sends down the revelation by His command to whoever He wills of His servants to warn ˹all˺ of the Day of Meeting—

q: will all come forward and nothing of theirs
(They will therefore be rewarded or punished for everything.) (On the Day of Qiyaamah, when nothing but Allaah will be Alive, Allaah will announce),
“To Whom does all Kingdom belong today?
(They will reply by saying that all kingdom belongs)
To Allaah, the One, the Omnipotent.”
v.s: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from God. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To God, the One, the Prevailing.
v.c: the Day all will appear ˹before Allah˺. Nothing about them will be hidden from Him. ˹He will ask,˺ “Who does all authority belong to this Day? To Allah—the One, the Supreme!

q: On this day every soul shall be recompensed
(without anyone having to suffer for the sins of others).
shall be done today! Verily, Allaah is Swift in Reckoning
v.s: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, God is swift in account.
v.c: Today every soul will be rewarded for what it has done. No injustice Today! Surely Allah is swift in reckoning.”

q: Warn them about the imminent day when
hearts will be at the throats, slowly swallowing
nor any intercessor who will be obeyed
(whose pleading on their behalf will be accepted).
v.s: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
v.c: Warn them ˹O Prophet˺ of the approaching Day when the hearts will jump into the throats, suppressing distress. The wrongdoers will have neither a close friend nor intercessor to be heard.

q: (the secret lustful glances that people make),
(the evil intentions that people have). (When Allaah knows even these most secret things, then certainly He knows everything else).
v.s: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
v.c: Allah ˹even˺ knows the sly glances of the eyes and whatever the hearts conceal.

q: worship besides Allaah cannot pass judgement in any affair
Verily, only Allaah is the All Hearing, the All Seeing
(and therefore Only He is capable of passing sound Judgement).
v.s: And God judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, God - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
v.c: And Allah judges with the truth, while those ˹idols˺ they invoke besides Him cannot judge at all. Indeed, Allah ˹alone˺ is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

q: (to the lands of nations that were destroyed),
so they may see what was the plight
before them? Those people were more powerful than them in terms of strength
and in terms of the landmarks
they left behind on earth. Nevertheless, Allaah seized
them on account of their sins.
They had none to protect them against
(When such powerful nations could not withstand Allaah's punishment, how will the weaker nations of later times withstand it?)
v.s: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but God seized them for their sins. And they had not from God any protector.
v.c: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might and ˹richer in˺ monuments throughout the land. But Allah seized them for their sins, and they had no protector from Allah.

q: came because Our Rusul used to come to them with clear signs
(to prove that they were true Ambiyaa ﵊),
(Because of their kufr, the punishment of)
Allaah seized them. Undoubtedly, He is Powerful, Severe in punishment.
v.s: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so God seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.
v.c: That was because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs, but they persisted in disbelief. So Allah seized them. Surely He is All-Powerful, severe in punishment.

q: Verily, We sent Moosa ﵊ with Our Aayaat and a clear proof
(his miracles which proved that he was truly Allaah's Rasool)...
v.s: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
v.c: Indeed, We sent Moses with Our signs and compelling proof

q: (the richest man among the Bani Israa'eel). (However, instead of accepting his message),
They said, “He is a magician and a liar.”
v.s: To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
v.c: to Pharaoh, Hamân, and Korah. But they responded: “Magician! Total liar!”

q: When he came to them with the truth from Us, they
said, “Kill the sons of those who believe in him
v.s: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.
v.c: Then, when he came to them with the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who believe with him and keep their women.” But the plotting of the disbelievers was only in vain.

q: (Seeing that Moosa ﵊ was amassing a large following,)
Fir'oun said, “Leave me to kill Moosa, and let him call for his Rabb
(to assist him). (O people! I am doing this for your benefit because)
I fear that he may change
your religion or that he may spread corruption on earth.”
v.s: And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land."
v.c: And Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Moses, and let him call upon his Lord! I truly fear that he may change your traditions or cause mischief in the land.”

q: Moosa ﵊ said, “I seek the protection of my Rabb and your Rabb from every haughty
person who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”
v.s: But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."
v.c: Moses replied, “I seek refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant person who does not believe in the Day of Reckoning.”

q: A Mu'min from Fir'oun's people, who
said, “Will you kill a man for saying 'Allaah is my Rabb', when he has brought the truth to you from your Rabb? If he is lying, then his lies shall be to his own detriment.
(Why should we then have his blood on our hands?).
However, if he is truthful, a part of what
he has promised shall befall you. Verily, Allaah does not guide him who exceeds the limits and is a liar.”
v.s: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is God' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, God does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.
v.c: A believing man from Pharaoh’s people, who was hiding his faith, argued, “Will you kill a man ˹only˺ for saying: ‘My Lord is Allah,’ while he has in fact come to you with clear proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, it will be to his own loss. But if he is truthful, then you will be afflicted with some of what he is threatening you with. Surely Allah does not guide whoever is a transgressor, a total liar.
v.h: The Believer’s Advice: 1) Do Not Persecute for Belief

q: today and are dominant in the land but
who can assist us against Allaah's punishment
(on account of assassinating His Rasool)?” (Feeling intimidated by the words of the Mu'min),
(to regain the complete support of his people),
“I am suggesting to you only what I regard
to be correct, and I am guiding you only towards the path of guidance
v.s: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of God if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."
v.c: O my people! Authority belongs to you today, reigning supreme in the land. But who would help us against the torment of Allah, if it were to befall us?” Pharaoh assured ˹his people˺, “I am telling you only what I believe, and I am leading you only to the way of guidance.”

q: The one who had Imaan said, “O my people! I fear that you may suffer a day of
v.s: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -
v.c: And the man who believed cautioned, “O my people! I truly fear for you the doom of ˹earlier˺ enemy forces—

q: of the nation of Nooh ﵊, the Aad, the Thamud and those
after them. Allaah never desires injustice for His bondsmen
(and will punish them only when they deserve punishment on account of their evil).”
v.s: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And God wants no injustice for [His] servants.
v.c: like the fate of the people of Noah, ’Ȃd, Thamûd, and those after them. For Allah would never will to wrong ˹His˺ servants.

q: “O my people! Verily I fear the day of Calling for you”
(referring to the Day of Qiyaamah when people will be called to account for their actions and they will also be calling to each other for help)...
v.s: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -
v.c: O my people! I truly fear for you the Day all will be crying out ˹to each other˺—

q: the day when you will turn back on your heels
(in an effort to run away from Jahannam)
and there shall be none to protect you from
Allaah. There can be no guide for the one whom Allaah sends astray.”
v.s: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from God any protector. And whoever God leaves astray - there is not for him any guide.
v.c: the Day you will ˹try in vain to˺ turn your backs and run away, with no one to protect you from Allah. And whoever Allah leaves to stray will be left with no guide.

q: “Without doubt, Yusuf ﵊ came to you with clear signs
(to prove that he was Allaah's true Rasool),
in constant doubt about what he brought to you until the time came when he passed away, then you said, 'Allaah shall never
(Allaah knows that it is futile to send another Rasul because we will reject him just as we rejected') Yusuf ﵊.')
Thus does Allaah allow those people to go astray who transgress
the limits and who are sceptical...”
v.s: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will God send a messenger after him.' Thus does God leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."
v.c: Joseph already came to you earlier with clear proofs, yet you never ceased to doubt what he came to you with. When he died you said, ‘Allah will never send a messenger after him.’ This is how Allah leaves every transgressor and doubter to stray—

q: “...those who dispute about Allaah's Aayaat without any warrant
coming to them. This is extremely detestable in the sight of Allaah and in the sight of those who have Imaan. Thus
(by allowing people to continue their evil ways)
does Allaah set a seal on the heart of every haughty
(hence they are unable to accept the truth).”
v.s: Those who dispute concerning the signs of God without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of God and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does God seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
v.c: those who dispute Allah’s signs with no proof given to them. How despicable is that for Allah and the believers! This is how Allah seals the heart of every arrogant tyrant.”

q: Fir'oun said, “O Haamaan, build a tower for me so that I may find the means...”
v.s: And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -
v.c: Pharaoh ordered, “O Hamân! Build me a high tower so I may reach the pathways

q: “...the means to the heavens so that I can have a close look at the Ilaah of Moosa ﵊ I strongly feel that he is a liar.” In this manner the evil of his actions was made appealing
to Fir'oun, and he was prevented from
The scheme of Fir'oun led only to destruction.
v.s: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.
v.c: leading up to the heavens and look for the God of Moses, although I am sure he is a liar.” And so Pharaoh’s evil deeds were made so appealing to him that he was hindered from the ˹Right˺ Way. But the plotting of Pharaoh was only in vain.

q: The one who had Imaan said, “O my people! Follow me and I shall lead you to the path of guidance
v.s: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
v.c: And the man who believed urged, “O my people! Follow me, ˹and˺ I will lead you to the Way of Guidance.

q: (because it will soon come to an end).
is really a place to live
(because it will not come to an end).'
v.s: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
v.c: O my people! This worldly life is only ˹a fleeting˺ enjoyment, whereas the Hereafter is truly the home of settlement.

q: shall be punished only for it
(without the punishment being increased). (On the other hand),
Whichever male or female carries out
a good deed as a Mu'min shall enter Jannah, where they will be sustained
(even though their deeds may have been limited).”
v.s: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.
v.c: Whoever does an evil deed will only be paid back with its equivalent. And whoever does good, whether male or female, and is a believer, they will enter Paradise, where they will be provided for without limit.

q: “O my people! How is it that I call you towards salvation, whereas you call me towards the Fire?”
v.s: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
v.c: O my people! How is it that I invite you to salvation, while you invite me to the Fire!

q: “You call me to disbelieve in Allaah and to ascribe such partners to Him for which I have no justification
On the other hand, I am calling you towards the Mighty, the Most Forgiving.”
(Wheres you ought to be listening to me, you endeavour to mislead me.)
v.s: You invite me to disbelieve in God and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
v.c: You invite me to disbelieve in Allah and associate with Him what I have no knowledge of, while I invite you to the Almighty, Most Forgiving.

q: towards which you call me have no claim
in this world or in the Aakhirah.
Our return shall certainly be to Allaah, and
will be the inmates of the Fire.”
v.s: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to God, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.
v.c: There is no doubt that whatever ˹idols˺ you invite me to ˹worship˺ are not worthy to be invoked either in this world or the Hereafter. ˹Undoubtedly,˺ our return is to Allah, and the transgressors will be the inmates of the Fire.

q: (after you are punished in this world or after you die)
(because you will realise that it is the truth). (Sensing that the people were not pleased with what he told them, he added),
I surrender my affairs to Allaah. Allaah is definitely Watchful over His bondsmen
(He will protect me against your evil).'
v.s: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to God. Indeed, God is Seeing of [His] servants."
v.c: You will remember what I say to you, and I entrust my affairs to Allah. Surely Allah is All-Seeing of all ˹His˺ servants.”

q: from the evils of the plots they made, and a terrible punishment enveloped the people of Fir'oun
(when they were drowned in the Red Sea).
v.s: So God protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
v.c: So Allah protected him from the evil of their schemes. And Pharaoh’s people were overwhelmed by an evil punishment:

q: will be presented before the Fire morning and evening
And, on the day that Qiyaamah will take place,
“Enter the people of Fir'oun into the worst of punishments.”
v.s: The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
v.c: they are exposed to the Fire ˹in their graves˺ morning and evening. And on the Day the Hour will be established ˹it will be said˺, “Admit Pharaoh’s people into the harshest punishment ˹of Hell˺.”

q: will argue with each other in the Fire. Then the weak ones will say to the haughty
a portion of the Fire from us?”
v.s: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"
v.c: ˹Consider the Day˺ when they will dispute in the Fire, and the lowly ˹followers˺ will appeal to the arrogant ˹leaders˺, “We were your ˹dedicated˺ followers, will you then shield us from a portion of the Fire?”

q: ones will say, “We are all together in the Fire
(and shall all suffer here for our kufr. We can neither help you nor ourselves).
Allaah has already passed judgement between His bondsmen
(and we have been doomed to Jahannam. There can be no reversing Allaah's judgement).'
v.s: Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, God has judged between the servants."
v.c: The arrogant will say, “We are all in it! ˹For˺ Allah has already passed judgment over ˹His˺ servants.”

q: The people in Jahannam will say to the keepers of Jahannam, “Supplicate to
v.s: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."
v.c: And those in the Fire will cry out to the keepers of Hell, “Pray to your Lord to lighten the torment for us ˹even˺ for one day!”

q: will ask, “Did your Rusul not come to you with clear signs
(miracles to prove that they were Allaah's true Ambiyaa ﵊)?”
The prayer of the Kaafiroon is lost
v.s: They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility]."
v.c: The keepers will reply, “Did your messengers not ˹constantly˺ come to you with clear proofs?” They will say, “Yes ˹they did˺.” The keepers will say, “Then pray! Though the prayer of the disbelievers is only in vain.”

q: We shall definitely assist Our Rusul and those who have Imaan in this worldly life as well as on the Day
v.s: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -
v.c: We certainly help Our messengers and the believers, ˹both˺ in this worldly life and on the Day the witnesses will stand forth ˹for testimony˺—

q: when the excuses of the oppressors will not benefit them, when they will be cursed
v.s: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home [i.e., Hell].
v.c: the Day the wrongdoers’ excuses will be of no benefit to them. They will be condemned, and will have the worst outcome.

q: to Moosa ﵊ and made the Bani Israa'eel inheritors of the Book
v.s: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture
v.c: And indeed, We gave Moses ˹true˺ guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the Scripture—

v.s: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.
v.c: a guide and a reminder to people of reason.

q: (and will soon come to you, O Rasulullaah ﷺ).
Seek forgiveness for your errors, and glorify the praises of your Rabb morning and evening.
v.s: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of God is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [God] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
v.c: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺, ˹for˺ Allah’s promise is certainly true. Seek forgiveness for your shortcomings. And glorify the praises of your Lord morning and evening.

q: Those who dispute about Allaah's Aayaat without any warrant
that has come to them have only pride in the hearts,
(attain until they accept Islaam.) (However, they cannot harm you in the least).
Allaah. Undoubtedly, only He is the All Hearing, All Seeing.
v.s: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of God without [any] authority having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in God. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.
v.c: Surely those who dispute Allah’s signs—with no proof given to them—have nothing in their hearts but greed for dominance, which they will never attain. So seek refuge in Allah. Indeed, He alone is the All-Hearing, All-Seeing.

q: The creation of the heavens and the earth is greater
than the creation of mankind, but most people
(While admitting that Allaah created the heavens and the earth, the Kuffaar refute resurrection, although resurrection is easier.)
v.s: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.
v.c: The creation of the heavens and the earth is certainly greater than the re-creation of humankind, but most people do not know.

q: (These people fail to realise that resurrection is necessary because)
The blind and the seeing cannot be equal, neither can those who have Imaan and who do good deeds be equal to the sinners.
(There will therefore have to be a time when the good must be rewarded and the sinners punished.) (However),
Little is it that they take heed
v.s: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.
v.c: Those blind ˹to the truth˺ and those who can see are not equal, nor are those who believe and do good ˹equal˺ to those who do evil. Yet you are hardly mindful.

q: There is indeed no doubt in the fact that Qiyaamah is imminent
However, most people do not have Imaan.
v.s: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.
v.c: The Hour is certainly coming, there is no doubt about it. But most people do not believe.

q: (in a manner that is most beneficial for you).
Verily, those who are too proud to worship Me shall soon enter Jahannam in
v.s: And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.
v.c: Your Lord has proclaimed, “Call upon Me, I will respond to you. Surely those who are too proud to worship Me will enter Hell, fully humbled.”

q: It is Allaah Who has made the night for you to rest, and has made the day for you to see
Without doubt, Allaah is Full of Grace
towards mankind, but most people are ungrateful
(and fail to worship Him when it is He Who gives them all they have).
v.s: It is God who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, God is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful.
v.c: It is Allah Who has made the night for you to rest in and the day bright. Surely Allah is ever Bountiful to humanity, but most people are ungrateful.
v.h: Allah Is Merciful to His Creation

q: This is Allaah, your Rabb, the Creator of everything. None besides Him is worthy of worship, so to where are you wandering
v.s: That is God, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
v.c: That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. How can you then be deluded ˹from the truth˺?

q: did those who rejected Allaah's Aayaat
(astray). (You should therefore beware that you do not suffer the punishment they suffered.)
v.s: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of God.
v.c: This is how those who used to reject Allah’s signs were ˹also˺ deluded.

q: It is Allaah Who made the earth a stable abode for you, and the sky a roof
Who fashioned you, beautified your appearances, and sustained you with pure things
This is Allaah, your Rabb. So Blessed is Allaah, the Rabb of the universe.
v.s: It is God who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure [i.e., ceiling] and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is God, your Lord; then blessed is God, Lord of the worlds.
v.c: It is Allah Who made the earth a place of settlement for you and the sky a canopy. He shaped you ˹in the womb˺, perfecting your form. And He has provided you with what is good and lawful. That is Allah—your Lord. So Blessed is Allah, Lord of all worlds.

q: He is the Living besides Whom no other deserves to be worshipped
So pray to Him, devoting worship solely to Him. All praise is for Allaah, the Rabb of the universe.
v.s: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to God, Lord of the worlds.
v.c: He is the Ever-Living. There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. So call upon Him with sincere devotion, ˹saying,˺ “All praise is for Allah—Lord of all worlds.”

q: from worshipping those whom you worship besides Allaah since the clear signs
have come to me from my Rabb. I have also been commanded to be obedient to the Rabb of the universe.”
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], “Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides God once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.”
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “I have been forbidden to worship those ˹idols˺ you worship besides Allah, since clear proofs have come to me from my Lord. And I have been commanded to ˹fully˺ submit to the Lord of all worlds.”
v.h: Allah Has Power over Life and Death

q: It is He Who created you
(He created the generations of man, whose development in the womb begins)
then from a clot of blood, after which Allaah extracted you
(after arriving in the world, Allaah preserves you)
and then to become old, the lives of some of you being taken first
so that you reach the appointed term
and so that you may understand
(Towheed and the purpose of your creation).
v.s: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.
v.c: He is the One Who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then ˹developed you into˺ a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He brings you forth as infants, so that you may reach your prime, and become old— though some of you ˹may˺ die sooner—reaching an appointed time, so perhaps you may understand ˹Allah’s power˺.

q: It is Allaah Who gives life and death. When He decides a matter, all He has to say
v.s: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.
v.c: He is the One Who gives life and causes death. When He decrees a matter, He simply tells it, “Be!” And it is!

q: Have you not seen those who dispute about Allaah's Aayaat? Where are they heading?
v.s: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of God - how are they averted?
v.c: Have you not seen how those who dispute Allah’s signs are turned away?

q: with which We sent Our Rusul
They shall soon come to know
(the error of their ways on the Day of Qiyaamah)...
v.s: Those who deny the Book [i.e., the ] and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,
v.c: ˹They are˺ the ones who reject this Book and all ˹scriptures˺ We sent Our messengers with. So they will know ˹the consequences˺

q: ...when yokes will be placed around their necks, as well as chains. They will be dragged...
v.s: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged
v.c: when shackles will be around their necks and chains ˹on their legs˺. They will be dragged

q: ...into the boiling water, after which they will be cast as fuel for the Fire.
v.s: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].
v.c: through boiling water, then burned in the Fire ˹as fuel˺.

q: Thereafter it will be told to them, “Where are those whom you ascribed as partners...
v.s: Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]
v.c: Then they will be asked, “Where are those ˹idols˺ you used to associate

q: (Will they not assist you today as you claimed in the world?)
They will reply, “They have been lost to us. In fact,
(it has now occurred to us that)
we never worshipped anything before this
(because the gods we worshipped in the world were really nothing and our worship was wasted).”
In this manner, does Allaah allow the Kaafiroon to stray.
(They worship gods whom they admit are powerless in the Aakhirah.)
v.s: Other than God?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does God put astray the disbelievers.
v.c: with Allah?” They will cry, “They have ˹all˺ failed us. In fact, we did not invoke anything ˹real˺ before.” This is how Allah leaves the disbelievers to stray.

q: (They will be told in the Aakhirah)
is because you were unjustifiably haughty on earth and because you were boastful.”
v.s: [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.
v.c: ˹They will be told,˺ “This ˹punishment˺ is for being prideful on earth unjustly and for acting arrogantly.

q: “Enter the gates of Jahannam where you will live forever. Evil indeed is the
v.s: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
v.c: Enter the gates of Hell, to stay there forever. What an evil home for the arrogant!”

q: (firm), (do not be distressed by the rejection and harassment of the Kuffaar)
is true. So if We were to show you
(if We punish them during your lifetime),
We were to claim your soul
(before punishing them or without punishing them),
(in any event, you should not worry because)
they shall be returned to Us
(after death and We shall then ensure that they are punished).
v.s: So be patient, [O Muhammad]; indeed, the promise of God is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.
v.c: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺. Surely Allah’s promise is true. Whether We show you some of what We threaten them with, or cause you to die ˹before that˺, to Us they will ˹all˺ be returned.

q: Verily We have sent many Rusul before you. Of them there are those whose narrations We have related to you, as well as those whose narrations We have not related to you.
(However, the common factor among all of them was that)
No Rasool had the power to produce a miracle
(and it was because of this that people opposed them, just as they oppose you). (This is bound to happen),
(when it does, do not be distressed because)
with the truth and, on that occasion, the people of falsehood will be at a loss.
v.s: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of God. So when the command of God comes, it will be concluded [i.e., judged] in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].
v.c: We already sent messengers before you. We have told you the stories of some of them, while others We have not. It was not for any messenger to bring a sign without Allah’s permission. But when Allah’s decree comes, judgment will be passed with fairness, and the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss.

q: Allaah created the livestock for you so that you may ride some of them
v.s: It is God who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.
v.c: It is Allah Who made cattle for you so that you may ride some and eat others.

q: the need in your hearts by riding them
(such as riding them for trade or for travelling).
(at sea, thus making your travels easy).
v.s: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried.
v.c: Also, you find in them ˹other˺ benefits. And by means of them you may reach destinations you desire. And you are carried upon ˹some of˺ them and upon ships.

q: And Allaah shows you His Aayaat
so which of Allaah's Aayaat will you reject
v.s: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of God do you deny?
v.c: And He shows you His signs. Now which of Allah’s signs will you deny?

q: not travel in the lands to see what was the plight
before them? Those people were more than them
in numbers, more powerful than them in strength and in terms of the landmarks they left behind on earth. However, everything they earned was of no use to them
v.s: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
v.c: Have they not travelled throughout the land to see what was the end of those who were ˹destroyed˺ before them? They were far superior in might and ˹richer in˺ monuments throughout the land, but their ˹worldly˺ gains were of no benefit to them.

q: When their Rusul brought the clear signs to them, they became arrogant
knowledge they had, and that which they mocked
v.s: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
v.c: When their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they were prideful in whatever ˹worldly˺ knowledge they had, and were ˹ultimately˺ overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

q: When they saw Our punishment, they said, “We believe in Allaah Alone and reject the partners we ascribed to Him.”
v.s: And when they saw Our punishment, they said, "We believe in God alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."
v.c: When they saw Our punishment, they cried, “˹Now˺ we believe in Allah alone and reject what we had been associating with Him!”

q: However, their belief could not benefit them when they saw Our punishment
(in way of dealing with the Kuffaar),
over His bondsmen. The Kaafiroon shall
v.s: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of God which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].
v.c: But their faith was of no benefit to them when they saw Our torment. This has ˹always˺ been Allah’s way ˹of dealing˺ with His ˹wicked˺ servants. Then and there the disbelievers were in ˹total˺ loss.
